summary: BL-010 automatic lifecycle: 139 automated checks and 42 combined browser checks passed, plus five checks against the built Worker. TypeScript and Worker build passed.

commands: WONDERWORKS_SECOND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5180 node --test test/lifecycle.browser.mjs test/rich-content.browser.mjs test/proposal-authoring.browser.mjs test/agent-guidance.browser.mjs test/workspace-sync.browser.mjs

limitations: Checks use disposable loopback projects and locally emulated authenticated identity; hosted OAuth expiry/revocation is not certified by these checks.
A saved hash is a user assertion of implementation, not remote Git inspection or passing verification. Deliberately failed evidence remained failed in the test workflow.
Unknown legacy status/provenance is preserved and flagged. Reconciliation is an explicit, version-guarded project write; ordinary reads never migrate data.
The five built-Worker checks repeat lifecycle scenarios against the packaged application, with an independent authenticated MCP client served by the development Worker sharing the local D1 database.

checks.title: Author requirements with measurable acceptance criteria
checks.detail: Browser/editor and shared API tests verify read-only normative status, Draft additions, pending labels, exact rich source and proposal-only persistence.

checks.title: Edit priority and display automatic requirement status
checks.detail: Domain and browser tests verify automatic approval, revision-specific implementation, retained current status for unchanged items, rejected overrides, and independent verification failures.

checks.title: Track meaningful requirement revisions
checks.detail: Authored comparison excludes status; tests preserve item/set revisions during commit writes, corrections, clears and reconciliation, while every authored-field change creates the next revision.

checks.title: Summarize project size and readiness
checks.detail: Two-browser tests show coherent status, separate Information counts and 100% readiness for accepted requirements. Edited pending revisions are labeled and counted as pending.

checks.title: Keep verification specific to the traced revision
checks.detail: A deliberately failed baseline check remains failed through implementation and clearing; newer unmatched revisions remain Not verified.

checks.title: Identify requirement changes since the latest baseline
checks.detail: Commit-driven metadata preserves authored content and revisions, frozen snapshots and requirement-set version; proposal staleness and authored diffs remain unchanged.

checks.title: Read current requirements and frozen implementation context through MCP
checks.detail: MCP reads expose current lifecycle provenance and all supports, pending outcomes, and exact original frozen statuses. Read-only tests prove no persistence.

checks.title: Draft requirement changesets through MCP
checks.detail: Shared staging validation accepts omitted/unchanged statuses, rejects overrides and non-Draft additions, and keeps authored diffs free of copied lifecycle changes.

checks.title: Submit and refresh MCP changesets for human review
checks.detail: Reviewed Apply atomically advances the authored set once, approves changed normative revisions, preserves unchanged implementation and creates an agreeing frozen snapshot.

checks.title: Persist a durable history for each requirement
checks.detail: Tests verify durable acceptance for every revision, same-revision lifecycle events, actor/trigger/snapshot/full-commit references, append-only history and atomic D1 persistence.

checks.title: Show requirement creation, acceptance, and lifecycle dates
checks.detail: History tests preserve creation and earlier milestones; Approved-to-Approved revised acceptance is recorded; last-support loss records its reason. Recovered unknown dates remain unknown.

checks.title: Verify requirement history and lifecycle behavior
checks.detail: Executed history/API/domain/D1/browser suites cover exact before/after records, deletion, legacy gaps, pagination, retries, rollback, restart and project isolation.

checks.title: Link an implementation commit ID to a requirement snapshot
checks.detail: Existing commit validation, whole-reference replacement, normalization/no-op, repository preservation and correction history pass alongside the new exact-revision status policy.

checks.title: Expose and verify proposal-to-snapshot and commit-to-snapshot links
checks.detail: Application API and MCP agree on commit metadata, affected requirements, all supports, statuses and versions. Inclusion links, frozen exports and verification remain unchanged.

checks.title: Keep accepted content unchanged until proposal application
checks.detail: Accepted authored requirements remain untouched during proposal staging and lifecycle metadata updates; only reviewed Apply promotes authored changes.

checks.title: Verify proposal-based editing and accepted-view isolation
checks.detail: All prior authoring and CP-006 browser checks pass with the new lifecycle, preserving guarded dirty edits, explicit review, retries, contexts, navigation and cross-Worker synchronization.

checks.title: Remind agents to record the implementation commit on the target snapshot
checks.detail: Guidance now requests snapshot reference readback plus affected-current-revision checks, and separates implementation from passing tests. The temporary real Git multi-commit workflow passes.

checks.title: Approve requirements when a proposal is accepted
checks.detail: Mixed Apply tests include additions, changed Implemented and Approved revisions, unchanged Implemented requirements, deletion and Information. No-op/restore preserve implementation.

checks.title: Mark matching current revisions Implemented when a snapshot receives a commit
checks.detail: Any exact matching committed snapshot qualifies. Mixed revisions, old snapshots, carried-forward items, multiple supports, replacement, normalized no-op and final clear all pass.

checks.title: Save lifecycle transitions without changing content revisions
checks.detail: Real D1 tests inject failure after receipt insertion and race competing writes: reference, statuses, provenance, events, Activity and receipt persist together or not at all; restart replay is stable.

checks.title: Reconcile existing statuses from saved acceptance and commit records
checks.detail: Explicit reconciliation recovers only changed exact accepted revisions and matching commits, preserves unknown/manual legacy assertions, distinguishes historical/reconciliation times, and is repeat-safe across restart.

checks.title: Verify automatic approval and revision-specific implementation
checks.detail: Repeatable domain/API/MCP/D1 and independent-browser checks exercise the full automatic lifecycle and preserve failed verification. Only executed results are included.
